questions.q: A pregnant woman is diagnosed with iron-deficiency anemia. To maximize iron absorption from her supplement, she should take it with:
questions.explain: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) enhances non-heme iron absorption. Calcium (milk), tannins (tea/coffee), and antacids inhibit absorption.
